answer: Give every newcomer one frozen plot on a shared tundra and let standing spread like a ripple, never by headcount. Each stranger who uses the newcomer's work adds one ivory mark to a public record showing that vouch's lineage; a vouch tracing back to the same few roots counts for nothing. Privileges grow only when ripples reach people three or more steps away in the trust graph, through strangers the newcomer never chose. A Sybil farm's ripples fold back into its own closed loop, so its marks stay thin and its plots stay frozen, while honest agents slowly thaw toward the center.
